text:
Ivy: Kickoff: AWS-focused marketplace onboarding thread. Scope: publisher IAM, KMS, marketplace manifest, and legal artifacts. Target: internal verify by Friday.

Noah: From infra: we need publisher role ARN, an assume-role trust that permits marketplace-provisioner, and a sample terraform snippet.

Elaine: Legal checklist: EULA PDF, privacy URL, MBSA text. Also need confirmation we can use our standard trial terms for starter SKUs.

Samir: KMS approach: create a CMK in publisher acct with a key policy allowing our provisioning role. Recommend rotation policy 90d and documented key ARN in manifest.

Ivy: Marketplace validator requires manifest fields: publisher_id, skus, endpoints, artifact_checksums, contact_email. I'll prepare the template.

InfraBot: Note: staging account for AWS tests is 210987654321. Credentials to be shared in the secure channel only.

Noah: I'll prepare terraform: role + inline policy + example kms attachment. Will push to repo and link here.

Elaine: I'll confirm EULA hosting location (docs.redwood.ai/legal/marketplace). Will add MBSA blurbs and attach DPA stub.

Samir: Uploading KMS examples to drive now. Also adding a short snippet for using Secrets Manager to hold publisher creds during onboarding.

Ivy: Action items: Ivy -> manifest template & publish checklist; Noah -> terraform + run billing smoke; Elaine -> legal artifacts; Samir -> kms + secrets examples. Plan quick 20m sync Thu 11am PT.

Noah: 11am PT ok.

Elaine: ok.

Samir: will be there.

Ivy: thanks team, posting doc link shortly and will tag reviewers.
